nightdash-bot: [ALERT] nightly-p95-signal: p95 latency increased 35% vs baseline across prod-gpu-pool-3 at 2026-03-18T00:36Z. top affected route: /generate. alert id: ND-20260318-09
Alex H: seeing it on canary too, p95 up ~220ms, tail looks worse than average :grimacing:
Maria T: noticed CI perf test failed on merge-refs/feature/batch-heuristic at 03:10. perf-runner flagged kernel-selector unit test timing out.
Sam R: linking the CI job output: https://ci.internal/redwood/3421/perf-run. logs show selection shifting to slower kernel for many short sequences.
Maria T: snippet from profiler:
```
commit 8f3a2b1 merged by @eng-releases
perf-regression: kernel-selector change (heuristic thresholds tightened)
# simplified trace
choose_kernel_for_seq(seq_len=16) -> kernel_v2 (slow path)
kernel_v2 exec 1.9ms vs kernel_v1 exec 0.7ms
```
Alex H: KV cache miss rate also jumped around the same window (+12%). could be related to batching window changes causing different cache warmup.
Eva P: I'll run a flamegraph on a canary instance now and dump to GCS: gs://perf-dumps/6042007777-flame.svg (ETA ~20m)
Jon L: hold rollout for the merge, put feature flag off for that commit. canary paused. :hand:
Sam R: starting bisect locally to confirm causality. quick bisect log:
```
$ git bisect start HEAD 8f3a2b1^
good: 8f3a2a0
bad: 8f3a2b1
bisect: test 3/5 -> repro at 8f3a2b1
```
Sam R: looks like the heuristic tweak in kernel_selector.cc:adjust_threshold is the culprit. reproduces with short-seq load profile.
Maria T: workaround idea: relax the threshold for seq_len <= 32 + re-enable opportunistic kernel_v1 selection for small batches. PR draft: https://phabricator/redwood/D1234
Alex H: can we hotfix on prod? small change, but need quick perf CI.
Jon L: prefer revert if safe — quicker to rollback for tonight. who can cut the revert?
Sam R: I can open the revert PR now and run the perf CI. will ping when green.
Eva P: flamegraph uploaded: https://gcs.redwood/perf-dumps/6042007777-flame.svg — shows heavy time in kernel_v2 path.
Alex H: thanks — that matches. if revert PR lands, plan: canary run 1 hour, then resume gradual rollout.
Maria T: adding test case to CI to catch kernel selection regressions for seq_len=8..32 profiles.
Jon L: ok let's hold the release and revert. Sam pls post revert PR link and ETA for perf-green. tagging @oncall for visibility.
Sam R: PR opened -> https://phabricator/redwood/D1235 (revert 8f3a2b1). running perf CI now. ETA ~25m.
nightdash-bot: will keep monitoring p95 and KV miss metrics, will post updates.
Alex H: appreciate the quick triage team. we'll reconvene in 30m or when CI completes. :thumbsup:
